sample_unit: LLM-generated treatment plans (one per model), each scored by six blinded reviewers

links.outcome: Whether LLM hypertension treatment plans provided sources
links.effect: LLMs often did not provide sources; composite scores varied widely (Perplexity 8.17/9 to Dyna AI 3.75/9).
links.quote: LLMs tended to adhere to clinical guidelines and provide detailed responses but often did not provide sources or instruct users to see a healthcare professional.

links.outcome: Whether LLM treatment plans instructed users to see a healthcare professional
links.effect: LLMs often did not instruct users to see a healthcare professional.
links.quote: LLMs tended to adhere to clinical guidelines and provide detailed responses but often did not provide sources or instruct users to see a healthcare professional.

screen.reason: The study evaluated and compared the accuracy, clarity, and safety of stage two hypertension treatment plans generated by multiple LLMs using clinician expert scoring.
